named_events.event_name: Gulf of Mexico Windstorm - Major Hurricane Galveston, Texas

data.standardized_narrative: The report's balance sheet shows gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2015 of approximately GBP 43.12m (used as opening claims reserves for 2016). The published accounts and notes in the PDF do not present a clear, extractable GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure; only net claims development tables and income-statement prior-year claims items are readily visible. As a result a quantified gross prior-year development figure could not be determined from the available pages. Several named catastrophe exposures are listed in the risk management section (e.g. Gulf of Mexico, Florida windstorm, California earthquake, European windstorm) but the report does not provide an unambiguous consolidated gross prior-year reserve movement amount.
data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross prior-year movement (gross PYD) could not be found in a clearly extractable form. The Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding prior-year comparative) was readable and used for opening reserves (page 12). The notes contain a claims development table but it is presented on a net basis (net triangle) rather than gross; therefore I did not compute a gross PYD from a net table. The report does show segmental and technical provisions tables but the gross movement note (Insurance liabilities column for 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding') could not be unambiguously identified in the scanned images. Where only net triangle or P&L prior-year claims (claims incurred in relation to prior years) appear, those were not used for gross PYD per instructions. Named catastrophe examples were taken from the Risk Management section (page 32) but individual event losses were not quantified in the visible pages. Many numeric tables are present in low-resolution scans; extraction of detailed gross-by-LOB movements and gross claims-development triangle was not possible with high confidence.
